find: '{{الزكاة}} → _zakat_ (compulsory charity in Islam, paid when certain income conditions are met)'

replace: '{{التيمّم}} → _tayammum_ (dry ritual purification: wiping the face and hands with clean earth when water is missing or cannot be used)'
